newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar ends week on firm note.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar ends week on firm note.

text.p: LIFFE white sugar futures pulled out of a slow downward drift late Friday to close around the week's highs, promising further gains.
Trade buying and shortcovering helped lift prices in relatively thin end-of-week trading and by the close August was trading at $321.50 a tonne, up $2.10 and turnover totalled 1,974 lots.
Earlier, bearish sentiment in New York dragged London white sugar futures lower.
"The trade do need to buy August," said one trader. "I think they've waited too long...and they're having to pay up for it."

In New York, the spot July contract expires at close of business on Monday although traders said they expected a hefty posting of against actuals business would reduce the large open interest still outstanding.
Paris futures ended with August trading at $320.00 a tonne, up $0.50, and total turnover was 717 lots.
Paris 100 ICUMSA traded 150 lots with October ending at $291.00 a tonne, down $0.50.
